title: Bayonetta: Bloody Fate
justification: Checked by title. The node moves from TVDB 357271 to the movie marker. TVDB series 357271 no longer exists. TheTVDB carries the film only as movie 21653 (ベヨネッタ ブラッディフェイト, 2013-11-23, 90 minutes), whose TMDB and IMDb ids are the node's own, so the node takes the movie marker and keeps its TMDB film.
